verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (eyebrow, headline, body, product, CTA). The circle is redrawn as a deliberate backdrop behind the bottle. Its flaws are small: the body copy breaks awkwardly, leaving 'sparkling.' alone on a line; the centred bottle and circle sit off the left text axis; and there is a slightly loose gap above the CTA. B moves 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the body copy, which breaks the eyebrow-to-headline order. Its headline is jammed against the cropped circle in the top-right corner. Its text is left-aligned while the bottle and CTA are centred, so the axes are mixed. The CTA is bigger than it needs to be, and the bottom has dead space.
